steps.caption: The API reference
steps.narration: This is the Customer API reference. Your own scripts read and update your ConstructHUB data with it.

steps.caption: No AI through the API
steps.narration: What it doesn't do: no AI. What you send is stored exactly as you sent it.

steps.caption: A key, read or write
steps.narration: Every request carries a key as a bearer token, with read, write, or both.

steps.caption: Units and limits
steps.narration: A read costs one unit plus one per hundred rows, and a write costs five.

steps.caption: Endpoints by resource
steps.narration: The endpoints are grouped by resource, from locations and reviews to Site Scans.

steps.caption: Search: reply
steps.narration: Search to find one. Type reply.

steps.caption: Reply to a review
steps.narration: This one replies to a Google review, published or saved as a draft.

steps.caption: Scope and cost
steps.narration: Open it: write scope, five units a call.

steps.caption: A minimal example
steps.narration: The minimal example shows the call: the address, your key and your reply's text.

steps.caption: Your API keys
steps.narration: Your keys live in Settings, under API keys.

steps.caption: Every key and its use
steps.narration: Each key shows its scope, units used this month, its own limit, when it was added and last used, and when it expires.

steps.caption: Generate API key
steps.narration: To add one, choose Generate API key.

steps.caption: Title, scope, limit, expiry
steps.narration: Give it a title, a scope, and an optional unit limit and expiry.

steps.caption: Confirm it's you
steps.narration: First you confirm it's you, with a code sent to your own email.

steps.caption: No key without the check
steps.narration: Cancel the check, and no key is made. Once you confirm, the key is shown once.

steps.caption: Rename, limit, revoke
steps.narration: From a key's menu you can rename it, set its limit, or revoke it.

steps.caption: Settings: API keys
steps.narration: You'll find your keys in Settings, under API keys.

youtube.title: Customer API in about a minute | ConstructHUB
youtube.description: A one-minute tour of the ConstructHUB Customer API: the API reference with its scopes, units and limits, how to find an endpoint and its minimal example, and where to create and manage your API keys. No AI runs through the API; what you send is stored exactly as sent.
